shape.means: square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth
soft, generous corners; friendly and calm

label.means: a saturated pill with a pointer line and a dot on the part (the classic)
a folded banner with forked tails
a tilted double-ruled stamp, inked, no fill

bubble.means: a sticky note taped up, tilted, with a folded corner
an inked, cut-cornered bubble with a sharp wedge tail
a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs

panel.means: a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)
a solid colour block with a hard offset shadow
a light sheet with a folded corner and faint rules

icon.means: an open ring with a gap and a bead, icon inside
a raised tile with a hard shadow, icon in colour
a rosette seal, icon knocked out

mark.means: a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark
tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)
a ruled box ticked by hand, the mark overflowing it

texture.means: diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.means: things drop in and land, panels settle
things slide in from the side they relate to
things fade up gently, labels wipe like type being set

camera.means: cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
the camera pans along a process or a row (guidance for the storyboard)
